## Format (6-Seat Council)

Each formal council follows the 6-seat format:
1. **Source-Grounded Archivist** — verifies claims against actual code/files
2. **Data Model Architect** — evaluates schema/data structure decisions
3. **Retrieval Specialist** — evaluates search/retrieval behavior
4. **Human Learning Advocate** — evaluates UX, developer experience, accessibility
5. **Skeptical Reviewer** — challenges assumptions, finds edge cases, identifies blind spots
6. **Synthesizer** — summarizes findings, assigns confidence, produces acceptance criteria

Each seat provides: confidence %, explicit dissent, blocking vs deferred triage, testable acceptance criteria.

## Supporting Docs

Some reviews have associated pre-council docs (context gathering before the formal review) and post-fix synthesis docs (verification after council findings were addressed). Page.json files accompany some council markdown docs for structured data.

## Future Reviews

All new council reviews should follow the 6-seat format and be written to Data/Pages/council/. Consider archiving reviews older than Sprint 30 to an archive-pre-sprint52 subfolder to reduce noise in the active directory.
